stage.name: Wolumonde
stage.description:
Beyond the town's gates is now desolation, the withered form of a land in decline. The sun has not yet risen, and winter quietly descends.
<'Gramophone'>Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, deals Arts damage to enemies and heals allies

leithanian_rebel_leader.name: Leithanian Rebel Leader
leithanian_rebel_leader.flavourText: One of Leithanien's local militia leaders. The widespread popularity of classical Originium Arts has made them more threatening, and their attacks inflict Arts damage.

winterwisp_hound_pro.name: Winterwisp Hound Pro
winterwisp_hound_pro.flavourText: A pack leader trained and utilized by locals since ancient times. For early aboriginals and pioneers, these hounds were considered invaluable partners.

leithanian_psalmist.name: Leithanian Psalmist
leithanian_psalmist.flavourText: An experienced Leithanian combatant who utilizes Arts. Their Arts are more powerful, and they will cast on L-44 'Gramophones' within their attack range to attempt to seize control of them.
abilities: Continuously casts at the nearest non-enemy controlled 'Gramophone' within attack range to attempt to seize control of it.

leithanian_whisperer.name: Leithanian Whisperer
leithanian_whisperer.flavourText: An Arts user commonly seen throughout Leithanien. They attack using Arts, and will cast on L-44 'Gramophones' within their attack range to attempt to seize control of them.
abilities: Continuously casts at the nearest non-enemy controlled 'Gramophone' within attack range to attempt to seize control of it.

winterwisp_hound.name: Winterwisp Hound
winterwisp_hound.flavourText: A hunting hound trained and utilized by locals since ancient times. For early aboriginals and pioneers, these hounds were considered invaluable partners.

leithanian_rebel.name: Leithanian Rebel
leithanian_rebel.flavourText: One of Leithanien's radicalized locals. The widespread popularity of classical Originium Arts has made them more threatening, and their attacks inflict Arts damage.

mudrock_zealot_leader.name: Mudrock Zealot Leader
mudrock_zealot_leader.flavourText: An elite of Mudrock's Sarkaz squad. Dancing on the edge of life and death has led them to develop a unique tactical system. Using Arts Resonance, they can generate a Barrier that absorbs Arts damage and grants additional Max HP and ASPD while it persists.
abilities: Has a Barrier that absorbs Arts damage.
Max HP and ASPD significantly increases while the Barrier persists.

mudrock_zealot.name: Mudrock Zealot
mudrock_zealot.flavourText: A member of Mudrock's Sarkaz squad. Dancing on the edge of life and death has led them to develop a unique tactical system. Using Arts Resonance, they can generate a Barrier that absorbs Arts damage and grants additional Max HP and ASPD while it persists.
abilities: Has a Barrier that absorbs Arts damage.
Max HP and ASPD significantly increases while the Barrier persists.

mudrock_matterllurgist_leader.name: Mudrock Matterllurgist Leader
mudrock_matterllurgist_leader.flavourText: A member of Mudrock's Sarkaz squad. Integrating Sarkaz tactics with Leithanian Arts to greater effect, they are capable of inflicting lethal damage with a block of energy, and prioritize attacking units closest to the contract entrance site.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking units that are vying for control of a 'Gramophone.'

hexed_colossus.name: Hexed Colossus
hexed_colossus.flavourText: This Originium construct, crafted by Mudrock, has been entwined with ancient Sarkaz witchcraft and now serves as an extension of its owner's will. The principle behind this Originium Art is quite obscure, but these constructs undoubtedly boast greater survivability and destructive power than normal Colossi.

mudrock_matterllurgist.name: Mudrock Matterllurgist
mudrock_matterllurgist.flavourText: A member of Mudrock's Sarkaz squad. Integrating Sarkaz tactics with Leithanian Arts, they are capable of inflicting lethal damage with a block of energy, and prioritize attacking units closest to the contract entrance site.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking units that are vying for control of a 'Gramophone.'

winterwisp_blood_magister.name: Winterwisp Blood Magister
winterwisp_blood_magister.flavourText: A mixed-blood well-versed in Winterwisp's ancient Blood Arts, much more terrifying than modern Casters. Their ancient sacrificial rituals are capable of instantly dealing area Arts damage, as well as severing Arts ley lines to seize control of L-44 'Gramophones.'
abilities: Will gradually lose HP over time
Upon death, deals a large amount of Arts damage to all surrounding units and immediately seizes control of any 'Gramophones'

winterwisp_blood_shaman.name: Winterwisp Blood Shaman
winterwisp_blood_shaman.flavourText: Locals who have studied the ancient Arts of Winterwisp are much more terrifying than modern Casters. Their ancient sacrificial rituals are capable of instantly dealing area Arts damage, as well as severing Arts ley lines to seize control of L-44 'Gramophones.'
abilities: Will gradually lose HP over time
Upon death, deals Arts damage to all surrounding units and immediately seizes control of any 'Gramophones'

mudrock_colossus.name: Mudrock Colossus
mudrock_colossus.flavourText: This Originium construct, crafted by Mudrock, does not possess sentience and must be directly controlled by Mudrock. Though bulky and slow, they are extremely durable and boast terrifying physical damage and survivability.
